latest_release.name: Zetica Photo v0.15.0
latest_release.notes_markdown:
## Zetica Photo Release v0.15.0

Official photo and image editor application for the **Zetica Creative Suite**. Rebuilt from scratch in pure Rust.

### Included Packages:
- `zetica-photo-v0.15.0-windows-x64.msi`: Native Windows Installer
- `zetica-photo-v0.15.0-windows-x64-portable.zip`: Portable standalone zip
- `photocraft-v0.15.0-windows-x64.msi`: Upstream compatible package

Developed by **Sam Pangilinan** ([zeticuz.xyz](https://www.zeticuz.xyz/)).
